description:
Replace all existing Logger-bridge and direct-Logger handlers with thin `OctoPi.Tracer.register/1` registrations.

Modules to port:
- `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/core_handler.ex` → `:ai_core`
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/agent_handler.ex` → `:agent`
- `apps/octo_pi_ai_openai/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/open_ai_handler.ex` → `:openai`
- `apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/anthropic_handler.ex` → `:anthropic`
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/telemetry_handler.ex` → `:coder_extension`

Each registration: call `OctoPi.Tracer.register/1` from the owning app's `Application.start/2`. The handler callback logs via `Logger` with `[domain: :octo_pi_tracer]` metadata using `OctoPi.Tracer.Formatter`.

Retire `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/logger.ex` (the old bridge) once all handlers are ported.

Add `{:octo_pi_tracer, in_umbrella: true}` to each affected app's deps.
title: Port AI-layer and extension telemetry handlers to Tracer
